checkpoint_kind: native kernel parameter and endpoint admission

qualification_this_checkpoint.admitted_scope: Known-invalid stored kernel ranges fail parsing before wrappers publish a scalar. Exact inverse-cosine endpoints retain zero and downstream division failure; arithmetic consumes a new proof of a defined rational endpoint, never an arbitrary cached zero.
adverse_results: The initial direct compiler driver omitted cfg allowlists; its failure is retained.
Candidate v2 passed parameter checks but lost exactness when adding one to a zero endpoint.
Broad cached-zero reuse passed the full scalar suite, then a new undefined-product diagnostic showed it erased a pending division by zero. That candidate is rejected and all its artifacts remain.
The first narrowed candidate used an unavailable Rational::cmp method; the compiler failure and corrected native comparison remain recorded.
The diagnostic summary writer failed on mixed Path/string keys after both subprocesses passed; a versioned summary reconstructs only the already-closed raw output.
Automatic approval review timed out before the modeling preparation launched; the permitted single retry succeeded. No work remains blocked by approval review.

All cost subprocesses completed successfully, but the summary assumed zero first-use retention for new arithmetic controls. That assumption failed in both revisions. The qualified summary preserves the original measurements, records identical 608/416-byte first-use retention, and cites a separate unchanged-workload three-batch followup with zero later retention.
The largest observed ratio of median instrumented times is about 1.049. All slower rows are retained; no speedup claim is made.
qualification_this_checkpoint.cost_interpretation: Instrumented matched controls retain all latency, allocation, retained-byte and peak measurements. They establish no general speedup or application performance claim. Correctness determines retention.
qualification_this_checkpoint.cost_scope: Five original valid import recipes in JSON/CBOR plus seven rational, radical, opaque and trigonometric arithmetic controls; 100000 operations per row and five alternating pairs. All-feature libraries include dispatch-trace. Instrumented timing supports no general performance claim.

cost_summary_correction.cause: The summary assumed zero retained bytes for every newly added arithmetic row. Both baseline and candidate retain the same 608 bytes for rational-add and 416 bytes for radical-add-fresh on first use.

qualification_this_checkpoint.decision: Retain native private-kernel parameter checks and defined inverse-cosine endpoint proofs. Reject broad cached-zero rational reuse.
qualification_this_checkpoint.input_domain: Dedicated rational reduced trigonometric kernels; exact rational or certified oversized constant sinc/cosc inputs; acos(1) and acosh arguments established by bounded rational-expression evaluation.
qualification_this_checkpoint.migration: Private rational kernel parameters outside their stored ranges now fail ParseError. Imported non-rational acosh arguments no longer receive an unproved positive sign solely from their tag; new evidence may resolve them. Accepted graph bytes remain unchanged. Defined endpoints now compose as exact zero. This is a correctness contract change, not a performance-only patch.
qualification_this_checkpoint.modeling_method: Cargo builds the public library in minimal and curve,sdf,metaballs,svg-io configurations; rustc then compiles unchanged integration sources against those exact libraries. Unrelated competitive C++ development dependencies and the full root CI matrix are not covered.
qualification_this_checkpoint.next: Address native domain obligations and quantile seed evidence before broader strict completion and the complete external release path.
owners: Hyperreal structural facts and shared quotient recognition
qualification_this_checkpoint.proof: Reuse the native half-pi parameter classifier and quotient evaluator. Its rational-only mode rejects opaque atoms and checks every operand and denominator before erasing zero terms. No untrusted numerical refinement is used for admission.
remaining_limitations: General non-leaf domain/range admission remains open. The baseline already gives a false zero fact to an undefined zero product; this patch prevents the new reader from erasing it but does not repair that general fact path.
NormalQuantile still trusts a bad seed: p=1/2 with the retained seed yields 100 at precision zero through both import and the native public constructor.
Finite valid private and public representation coverage does not prove every graph or constructor.
Full geometry/DRC runtime gates, actual affected foreign-language consumers, clean shipped-distribution validation and complete resource bounds remain open.
Historical missing artifacts were not reaudited or recovered; closed evidence relies on retained external paths.
qualification_this_checkpoint.resource_limitations: Endpoint recognition reuses existing 512-node, 64-depth, 8192-operation and 4096-bit coefficient limits. These are optional proof limits, not a complete import-time or heap-byte bound. General decoding, coefficients, and expression growth require external containment.

tmp_amendment.authorization: User authorized tmp validation. This extends an agent-selected temporary-storage ceiling; no additional user storage authorization is inferred for Disk B or logs.
tmp_amendment.reason: Preserve both rejected and final-source builds while finishing modeling, compiler-floor and cost checks. Reuse the current final-source cache. Only the agent-selected temporary ceiling changes; original baselines, user caps and workloads remain.
